---
title: "Condensed version"
link-citations: true
---

Users may start with the condensed version of TYPE-ME. It captures the main, substantively distinct types of methods research and may be sufficient for broad planning, teaching, discussion, or preliminary classification.

::: {.condensed-typology}
| | Types of methods research | Relationship to detailed typology |
|---|---------------------------|-------------------------------|
| 1 | Theory-based methods research | [A1](approaches/1theory.qmd) |
| 2 | Simulation studies | [A2](approaches/2simulation.qmd) |
| 3 | Methods research based on real data | [A3](approaches/3real-datasets.qmd), [A4](approaches/4reliability.qmd) |
| 4 | Methodological randomized studies | [A5](approaches/5randomized.qmd) |
| 5 | Surveys, interviews, or focus groups | [A6](approaches/6survey.qmd), [A7](approaches/7qualitative.qmd) |
| 6 | Consensus studies | [A8](approaches/8consensus.qmd) |
| 7 | Studies of applied methods | [A9](approaches/9review-applied.qmd), [A10](approaches/10meta-epi.qmd) |
| 8 | Syntheses of methods research | [A11](approaches/11scoping-review.qmd), [A12](approaches/12qualitative-synthesis.qmd), [A13](approaches/13quantitative-synthesis.qmd) |
| 9 | Methods guidance and tools | [O9](objectives/9guidance-applying.qmd), [O10](objectives/10guidance-reporting.qmd), [O11](objectives/11guidance-assessing.qmd), [O12](objectives/12software-code.qmd) |
| 10 | Methodological implementation research | [O13](objectives/13implementation.qmd) |
:::

The condensed version groups related types and omits some detail, especially in the objective dimension. Users who need this detail can move to the [detailed typology](explore.qmd), with its terminology notes, boundary notes, and examples.

## Adapting the typology to your needs
Adapt the condensed version to your purpose by selecting, combining, splitting, or adding types—for example, for broad classification, teaching, or work in a focused area.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal" collapse="true"}
## How we developed the condensed version
Testing showed that the detailed typology can be too complex for classification and teaching. We therefore regrouped the test papers into 10 categories based on their main approach or objective; the preprint describes the process.[@Schandelmaier2026how]
:::
